reason: I have never heard of this store and I would be spending $300+ on a light for a kitchen I am midway through. I would price-check it against stores I already know before handing over a card.
objection: Unknown store, 10 to 12 business days is a long wait with the electrician due in three weeks, and I pay return shipping on a big fragile fixture if it is not right.
would_change_my_mind: Free returns, a firm delivery date, and solid independent reviews of the store, plus a promo code deeper than 10% off.
